name: awesome-alt-clouds
description: A list of specialized clouds that span traditional infra, AI, data, connectivity, and more.

paragraphs: A curated list of Alt Clouds — non-hyperscale cloud providers delivering specialized infrastructure and services.

Alt Clouds provide value "as a service" directly on top of infrastructure. They cater to specific workloads, compliance requirements, and developer needs, offering transparency, automation, and critical services with public SLAs.
Browse the live directory and use the browser extension at alt-cloud.org.
